The '''Borleias starfighter training base''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] installation established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] by [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], after the world was [[Second Battle of Borleias|captured]] by New Republic forces. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm]] trained [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]], a unit of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]], at the base. The unit would later participate in the [[Battle of Ession]].
